item.question: Why is it important to consider dependent data structures in Monte Carlo simulations?
item.answer: Considering dependent data structures is crucial because ignoring them can lead to biased or misleading conclusions. When multiple models are fitted on the same dataset without acknowledging these dependencies, it may result in overconfidence about results' robustness or misinterpretation regarding variable effects.
